title: Photorealistic 3D Map Explorer, Camera Tour & 3D Trail Route
name: Photorealistic 3D Map Explorer, Camera Tour & 3D Trail Route
user_prompt: Create an interactive Photorealistic 3D terrain storytelling and trail exploration web app in Lake Tahoe using the Maps JavaScript API 3D capabilities (<gmp-map-3d> / Map3DElement). Render a realistic 3D mountain and lake view featuring an extruded 3D hiking trail route path in bright red RGB(255, 0, 0), interactive 3D trailhead and viewpoint markers, and a live elevation profile fetched from the Elevation API. Include chapter tour buttons that trigger smooth 3D camera fly-to animations across scenic viewpoints (adjusting tilt, heading, and range), plus a Places search bar to fly the 3D camera to any user-searched landmark.

3D hiking route polyline is visible in red color RGB(255, 0, 0) with 3D viewpoint markers
Camera tour preset controls smoothly update 3D camera position, tilt, and heading
